svg.title: PostgreSQL full-query over pg_ivm update-plus-query speedup
svg.desc: Receipt-generated heatmaps with row count horizontally, batch size vertically, and separate memory budget and exact join fanout panels. Numeric labels are medians with measured minimum to maximum ranges.
svg.text: Median centered in each measured cell; second line is measured min–max. Values above 1 mean lower pg_ivm time.
Total memory cap: UNENFORCED. PostgreSQL tuning profiles are shown as separate panels.
